title: Microstructures and anomalous magnetic properties of C@Ni–NiO nanoparticles synthesized by a homogeneous precipitation method
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,16677-16689
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02174J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zhen-Fei Yu, Kun-Yu Su, Duan-Qing Chen, Yu-Ru Ding, Yi Zhang, Wei Zhong, Xue-Min He
A C@Ni–NiO structure contains carbon spheres and Ni/NiO nanoparticles. The coupling interactions between ferromagnetic Ni and antiferromagnetic NiO phases resulted in an exchange bias of 30 Oe and a coercivity enhancement of 9 Oe at 5 K.
